patch_boundary.add: MouthDogAI.OnCollideWithEnemy(Collider, EnemyAI) Priority.First prefix that skips only when collidedEnemy is validated LethalMin.PikminAI

partial_runtime_proven: The first S1.42AH runtime run proves adapter-side patch installation, repeated live Vanilla MouthDog -> Pikmin collision blocking, and exercised MouthDog -> player maul/kill preservation.
The second targeted run explicitly throws Pikmin onto MouthDogModel; Pikmin latch, enter AttackEnemy, and repeatedly damage the MouthDog through native LethalMin behavior.
The Pikmin attack path kills MouthDog(Clone); native cleanup immediately sets attackers idle, removes the attack task and leader, and unlatches them.
After death, MouthDogBody(Clone) becomes a PikminItem and Pikmin transition into CarryItem and grab/carry the corpse, preserving native post-death ownership.

The adapter-side MouthDogPikminGuard executes during live MouthDog/Pikmin gameplay before bite RPC, GrabbedPikmin bookkeeping or GrabPikmin mutation; no Biting N Pikmin, EnemyAttackMouth, 2.5-second GrabPikmin mutation, or Dog-path Pikmin HitEnemy(2) signature appears in the targeted gameplay interval.
Known project regression markers remain clean in the second run: Work state with no task assigned, Leader is null when following, S1.39 Compatibility Fixes errors and Fatal markers are all zero.
Ordinary MouthDog audible-noise response remains active in the second run, including Heard noise, targetPos and lastheardnoisePosition messages.
